# Session traces

Every LLM session in this repo is published here: what was asked, what the agent did, what it cost in tokens, and which commits came out of it.
This page adds up all the sessions. Each session's folder has a readable `summary.md`, the detailed `manifest.json`, and links to the full redacted log.
The [procedure](../README.md#procedure-for-agents) says how traces are made, and the [specification](../specification.md) defines them.

${glance}

## Sessions

Oldest first. *Elapsed* is the time from first to last message, so it includes pauses. *Peak context* is the most tokens in any one model call.

${sessions}

${empty}

## Tokens

Each model call re-reads its context, so tokens read far outnumber tokens written. *Cached* is the share of tokens read that came from the prompt cache, which costs much less than fresh input.

${tokens}

## Tool calls

${tools}

## Commits

Every commit with a trace, oldest first, with the sessions it carries a trace for. A feature that spans sessions appears once and names each of them.

${commits}

## Logs

Logs are immutable snapshots: each commit points at the log as it stood when the commit was made. Only snapshots that a commit points at are uploaded. *Size* is gzipped, over all of a session's snapshots.

${logs}

## Session notes

Corrections and context, written by hand, for what a session's log and commits cannot say.

${notes}

## Reading these numbers

- All figures come from the manifests in this folder, so they can be rebuilt from the repo. There are no dollar costs, because a manifest does not record what any call was billed.
- An open session is still growing. Its figures here run ahead of its uploaded logs until the next push.
- A session is one Claude Code conversation, including everything after a compaction. It can cover unrelated work, and the work need not be in this repo.
- Commit totals count each commit once, so they can be lower than the sum of the sessions' commit counts.
